packageRules.description: Group RN-core-coupled upgrades so incompatible RN/library pairs never merge alone (same rule as syscd-app)

The Expo SDK decides these versions in client/ (expo-doctor fails CI on any other). Minor/patch moves go through `bunx expo install --check`, not Renovate; majors (SDK upgrades) still open, grouped above for RN core.

expo-router is pinned to 58.0.23 on purpose: later 58.0.x patches replace the browser history entry on tab navigation (docs/evidence/parity/REPORT.md, regression 1). Unpin by hand after checking browser Back.
Hold ESLint <10 and TypeScript <7 majors (same rule as syscd-app: plugins do not support them yet)
